subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers adopt and refresh https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/544, ask the contributor to refresh it, or create a same-repository replacement for this Control UI resolver fix?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible, but an open cross-repository PR already contains a focused candidate fix and blocks duplicate automated repair; choosing adoption, contributor refresh, or replacement is maintainer workflow judgment.

options.title: Adopt or replace the linked PR
options.body: Use the existing focused patch as source material, but land a current-main same-repository or maintainer-editable PR with real Control UI proof.

options.title: Ask contributor to refresh
options.body: Keep the fork PR as the implementation path and ask its author to update it onto current main with real behavior proof.

options.title: Decline the discovery-card behavior
options.body: Close the issue and linked PR only if maintainers decide custom-only snapshots should intentionally hide unconfigured built-in channel cards.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing focused patch as source material, but land a current-main same-repository or maintainer-editable PR with real Control UI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal on the channel UI metadata/catalog boundary and is the best available owner for adoption-versus-replacement direction.
